content:
FINAL FIX — MAKE AUTONOMOUS ACTIVITY VISIBLE IN THE IVX APP

The backend report says autonomous is active, but I cannot see live activity in the app.

Do not return another backend-only narrative.

Trace the complete visibility chain:

SCHEDULER
→ JOB EXECUTION
→ DATABASE PERSISTENCE
→ API RESPONSE
→ FRONTEND QUERY
→ DASHBOARD RENDER
→ CRM/MODULE RECORD

1. VERIFY THE DASHBOARD ROUTE

Confirm the real route and navigation entry for:

expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx

Return:

- exact app route
- menu location
- owner permission requirement
- whether it is linked from Owner Dashboard
- whether it opens on Android and web

Add a visible button named:

AUTONOMOUS LIVE WORK

inside:

- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- IVX IA Chat
- Control menu

2. VERIFY LIVE API CONNECTION

The dashboard must read live production data from:

- /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger
- /api/ivx/autonomous/auth-guardian
- /api/ivx/autonomous/qa
- /api/ivx/autonomous/credentials

For each endpoint return:

- HTTP status
- authenticated owner result
- response count
- latest timestamp
- running jobs
- completed jobs
- failed jobs
- blocked jobs

Do not use mock data.

3. FIX PERSISTENCE

The report says 556 runs completed without persisted evidence.

This is not acceptable.

For every job, persist:

- job ID
- engine name
- worker ID
- started_at
- completed_at
- status
- records discovered
- records saved
- errors
- source URL
- proof artifact
- next action

No completed job may disappear after restart.

Add database constraints and tests.

4. CONNECT LEADS TO REAL MODULES

Buyer engine results must appear in:

- Buyers CRM
- Lead Pipeline
- Opportunity Matching

Investor engine results must appear in:

- Investors CRM
- Capital Pipeline

JV engine results must appear in:

- JV Deals
- Partner Pipeline

Tokenized buyer results must appear in:

- Tokenized Investors
- Capital Outreach

Technology ideas must appear in:

- Innovation Dashboard
- Research Queue

For every result, show:

- source
- category
- score
- date found
- status
- assigned agent
- outreach status

5. SHOW LIVE METRICS

The dashboard must show:

- scheduler status
- last heartbeat
- active workers
- jobs running
- jobs completed today
- jobs failed today
- buyers found today
- investors found today
- JV leads found today
- tokenized buyers found today
- technology ideas found today
- outreach queued
- outreach sent
- evidence saved
- evidence missing

Refresh every 15–30 seconds.

6. ADD REAL-TIME JOB CARDS

Each job card must show:

- engine
- task ID
- current stage
- progress
- records found
- records saved
- last update
- exact error if blocked
- retry button
- cancel button
- open proof button

No fake percentages.

7. VERIFY OWNER ACCESS

Test:

- owner login → dashboard opens
- non-owner → 403
- no token → 401
- session restore → dashboard still loads
- expired session → clear login prompt

8. RUN ONE LIVE TEST PER ENGINE

Execute and show one real run for:

- Buyer engine
- Investor engine
- JV engine
- Tokenized buyer engine
- Capital outreach engine
- Technology ideas engine

For each return:

- job ID
- start time
- finish time
- source count
- records discovered
- records saved
- module where visible
- proof record ID

9. FINAL ACCEPTANCE

PASS only when I can open the IVX app and visibly see:

- autonomous dashboard
- live running jobs
- completed jobs
- discovered leads
- saved CRM records
- technology ideas
- outreach queue
- timestamps
- proof evidence

FINAL REPORT

DASHBOARD ROUTE:
PASS / FAIL

LIVE API:
PASS / FAIL

JOB PERSISTENCE:
PASS / FAIL

CRM SYNC:
PASS / FAIL

REAL-TIME UI:
PASS / FAIL

OWNER ACCESS:
PASS / FAIL

BUYER ENGINE:
PASS / FAIL

INVESTOR ENGINE:
PASS / FAIL

JV ENGINE:
PASS / FAIL

TOKENIZED ENGINE:
PASS / FAIL

OUTREACH ENGINE:
PASS / FAIL

TECHNOLOGY ENGINE:
PASS / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS VISIBILITY:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / FAIL

Do not mark VERIFIED until the activity is visible inside the production IVX app, not only in backend logs.
